chunks: Will you believe it when it comes to pass? Indeed, you will believe it then. How impatient you were to hasten it!

key_terms.تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ: you were hastening or eager for
key_terms.وَقَعَ: to occur or come to pass

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the disbelievers' reaction when divine punishment finally arrives?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the psychological state of the disbelievers who, driven by arrogance, actively hastened the arrival of divine punishment (tas'tijal) rather than waiting for it. It serves as a critique of superficial faith that arises only from the compulsion of reality, contrasting with the steadfast belief of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams who accept divine decree with patience and conviction.
